LicenseKey.title: LicenseKey
LicenseKey.description: Single-device license key with activation-triggered daily expiration. Document ID is the normalized uppercase key code.

durationDays.description: Number of days the license remains valid starting from first activation (1 to 3650).

status.description: Administrative status of the license key.

boundDeviceId.description: Optional hashed unique Android device identifier bound to this key. Null or absent when unused or reset.

boundDeviceModel.description: Optional human-readable device model string (e.g., Pixel 8) for admin reference.

boundUserId.description: Optional Firebase Auth UID of the user who bound this key.

activatedAt.description: Optional server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() when first activated.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp calculated upon first activation and adjustable by admin.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

AdminKeyNote.title: AdminKeyNote
AdminKeyNote.description: Admin-only buyer metadata isolated from licenseKeys for strict PII protection.

buyerNote.description: Buyer name or administrative note (0 to 200 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

AdminSecurityConfig.title: AdminSecurityConfig
AdminSecurityConfig.description: Admin-only salted SHA-256 hash of the secret Admin Panel PIN.

pinHash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of salt and admin PIN (64 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() upon creation (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on every write.

/licenseKeys/{keyCode}.description: Single-device license keys indexed by uppercase key code.

/adminKeyNotes/{keyCode}.description: Admin-only buyer notes paired 1:1 with licenseKeys by key code.
